extracted.subtask_description: A handbook/index for news-writing that enumerates the many topical categories and narrative treatments reporters may use (accidents, human-interest animal pieces, court coverage, sports, investigations, meetings, etc.). Intended to help reporters identify story types and appropriate treatments.
